description: Verifies the domain for MailMoose and authorises MailMoose to send mail from it. Leaves the domain's MX records alone, so mail it already receives elsewhere keeps arriving there.
variableDescription: dkim1, dkim2, dkim3: Amazon SES DKIM tokens, which verify the domain for receiving mail. pmselector: the Postmark DKIM selector, e.g. 20261018192056pm. pmdkimkey: the Postmark DKIM public key, the base64 after p=.
